newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL -- Raytheon falling.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL -- Raytheon falling.

text.p: Raytheon Co's shares fell in early pre-open actvity and were expected to continue down in search of support after the company issued a warning on third quarter results.
Raytheon shed 1-1/8 to 51-7/8 soon after issuing the warning this morning, and traders said they expected the shares to decline further.

Raytheon said it expected operating income for the third quarter to be about 15 percent below the year-ago level after adjusting for the 1995 sale of D.C. Heath and the impact of a recent eight-week strike at the company.

Raytheon also said it expects earnings per share for the third quarter to be about in line with analysts' expectations, excluding a previously announced charge of $.09 per share, or $22 million after-tax.
According to Zack's Investment Research, the consensus Wall Street forecast for Raytheon's third quarter is $0.89 per share, up from $0.82 a year earlier.

Elsewhere in pre-open trade, KinderCare Learning Centers Inc shares jumped to 20 from 16-1/4 on the news last night that the company had agreed to merge with a Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co affiliate in a deal valued at about $600 million.
KinderCare shareholders would receive $20.25 cash per share.
Traders also expect weakness in the shares of Dole Food Co Inc.
Dole said last night it expects third quarter results to be "in line with the lower end of analysts' estimates" but "significantly above last year."
First Call said its consensus estimate for Dole's third quarter is $0.44 per share. For the year-earlier period the company earned $0.27 a share.
